summary: Iteration-7 tested the three new admin features: (1) manual deposit, (2) admin-as-vendor 'My store (sell)' with 100% commission, (3) promo banner editing. Backend: added TestIter7ManualDeposit (8 tests), TestIter7AdminStore (4 tests) and TestIter7PromoBannerPersistence (1 test) — 13/13 pass. Covered: POST /api/admin/deposits/manual credits wallet instantly (status=approved, manual=true, reviewed_by=admin, reference MAN-xxxx), writes a deposit.manual audit entry (target_id=deposit.id), sends buyer notification 'Deposit approved'; validation: unknown email → 404, duplicate TXID (manual↔manual and manual↔normal) → 400, amount<=0 → 422, non-admin → 403, TXID optional. Admin products (POST /vendor/products while role=admin): status=approved immediately, vendor_name='NeonKeys Official'; bulk import creates N products all approved. Buyer purchasing an admin product gets commission_pct=100, vendor_earning_cents=0, delivery works; the order appears in admin's GET /vendor/sales. Regression: normal vendor products still status=pending. Promo banner: PUT /admin/site mutating only banners updates title/subtitle/button_text and is reflected in GET /site. Found & fixed 1 small normalization bug: /wallet/deposits/{id}/txid lowercases the TXID before storage but admin_manual_deposit stored body.txid.strip() raw — a buyer could reuse a manual-deposit TXID with different casing. Added .lower() to match (one-char fix in server.py). Frontend (Playwright): admin → Add-fund requests shows the 'Add funds manually' button; dialog has email/amount/coin/txid/note/submit fields; after submission dialog closes, 'manual · admin@market.com' badge is rendered on each manual row under the Approved filter. Admin → 'My store (sell)' tab embeds VendorDashboard (no PageHeader because embedded=true, no 'withdrawals' tab) and shows admin-store-note 'Sold as NeonKeys Official. Your listings go live instantly and 100% of each sale is platform revenue.' Public shop banner on / is back to original text after teardown.

minor.issue: Pre-fix: admin_manual_deposit stored body.txid.strip() while /wallet/deposits/{id}/txid stores .strip().lower(), so a buyer could reuse the same TXID with a different case and bypass the unique partial index. Fixed in this iteration by adding .lower() to the manual branch.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_manual_deposit now normalizes txid with .strip().lower() to match /wallet/deposits/{id}/txid. Consider centralizing TXID normalization in a single helper (`def norm_txid(s): return s.strip().lower() or None`) and reusing in both places and in approve/reject paths to avoid future drift.

ManualDeposit.jsx: the <select data-testid="manual-deposit-coin"> iterates `[...Object.keys(COIN_LABEL), 'OTHER']` — if COIN_LABEL already contains 'OTHER' (it does, with label 'Other / cash') you'll render two <option value='OTHER'>. Not a correctness bug but produces duplicate option DOM. Suggest `[...new Set([...Object.keys(COIN_LABEL),'OTHER'])]`.
ManualDeposit submit sends txid as `f.txid || null` but the backend model Field(default=None, max_length=200) accepts an empty string too; aligning the UI to always send null when blank is cleaner.

Backend admin_manual_deposit returns `dep` with `dep.pop('_id', None)` only after insert + inc balance; if the second update fails the dep is already inserted. Low risk (wrapped nothing can race), but a $inc failure would leave an approved deposit with no actual credit. Consider a transaction or compensating delete on failure.

The listing_status helper returns {'status':'approved','approved_at':now} for admin — matches spec. However admin product edits via PUT /vendor/products/{id} also re-apply listing_status(user), so admin edits never flip to pending (good). Nothing to change; just worth noting that an admin price change does not re-trigger review.

Pre-existing (iter-4/iter-6): TestIter6HeroBannersNotice::test_category_icon_color_persistence can race with TestIter7PromoBannerPersistence under xdist LoadScope because both snapshot /admin/site at setup_class and overlap PUTs; serially the test passes. Not a product bug — a test-isolation improvement would be to serialize these two classes or scope them to the same worker.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (manual deposit dialog + approved row marker + admin store note + banner restored)

rca of the issue: Minor casing bug in admin_manual_deposit: body.txid was stored verbatim while /wallet/deposits/{id}/txid stored .lower(). The unique index on deposits.txid is case-sensitive, so a buyer could submit a normal deposit with a differently-cased copy of a manual TXID and bypass the duplicate check. Reproduction: as admin POST /admin/deposits/manual with txid='ABC123'; as buyer start /wallet/deposits then submit /txid with 'abc123' → both accepted. Mitigation shipped: added .strip().lower() in admin_manual_deposit so TXIDs collide in the index. Tested by TestIter7ManualDeposit::test_manual_deposit_blocks_normal_deposit_reuse.
